dedupe_keys.name: basque y high speed railway life cycle inventories and impact scenarios

description: This deposit contains construction, maintenance and operating inventories for the 190-kilometre Basque Y mixed-traffic high-speed railway in Spain. The research team combines mapped bridges, tunnels and earthworks with passenger assumptions for 2020, 2030, 2040 and 2049 and freight projections for 2023–2050. Thirteen Excel and Word files provide inventories, transport-mode factors and impact results for optimistic and realistic scenarios. Mendeley version 3 offers free CC BY 4.0 access. The line was still under construction in the study’s 2023 reference state, so these projections are not measured operating outcomes. Results use openLCA and ecoinvent 3.7; the deposit licence does not establish unrestricted access to the underlying commercial ecoinvent database. A reviewer-assessed use is parameterizing infrastructure-construction and modal-shift scenarios while preserving the study boundaries. model-sumo supplies a related transport simulation environment, at a different scale. No life-cycle calculation, spreadsheet formula or software import was checked.
